description: Anthropic just dropped Fable 5 and the performance jumps are wild. The agent encoding scored 11 points higher than Opus, and Stripe claims it compressed months of engineering work into days on a 50 million line Ruby codebase. The model can now beat complex games like Slay the Spire while maintaining context, which shows serious improvement in long-term reasoning and autonomous operation.
